title: Teddy and Peddy’s Magic Frog Picnic

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {wake} {stretch} Peddy, wake up! Today is our big *picnic* day!

segments.say: Peddy, wake up! Today is our big *picnic* day!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {rub-eyes} {yawn} Five more minutes… wait, picnic? {jump} I'm up!

segments.say: Five more minutes… wait, picnic?
I'm up!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {idea} Sandwiches, juice, cake… we pack everything!

segments.say: Sandwiches, juice, cake… we pack everything!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {hmm} And cookies. Lots of cookies. A mountain of cookies!

segments.say: And cookies. Lots of cookies. A mountain of cookies!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {laugh} Okay, okay, cookies too. Let's go raid the kitchen!

segments.say: Okay, okay, cookies too. Let's go raid the kitchen!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {yay} Picnic, picnic, picnic! {dance}

segments.say: Picnic, picnic, picnic!

lines.speaker: auto-mom
lines.text: {walk-to} Good morning, my little picnic monsters! {smile}

segments.say: Good morning, my little picnic monsters!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {hug} Good morning, Mom! We need food. All the food.

segments.say: Good morning, Mom! We need food. All the food.

lines.speaker: auto-mom
lines.text: {laugh} The normal sandwiches are on the table. Take those.

segments.say: The normal sandwiches are on the table. Take those.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {open:fridge} {sniff} Mom, what is this green sandwich glowing in here?

segments.say: Mom, what is this green sandwich glowing in here?

lines.speaker: auto-mom
lines.text: {shock} Don't touch that! It's Grandpa's *magic sandwich*!

segments.say: Don't touch that! It's Grandpa's *magic sandwich*!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {haan} Magic? What does it do?

segments.say: Magic? What does it do?

lines.speaker: auto-mom
lines.text: Nobody knows. Grandpa ate one and croaked all week! {shake-head}

segments.say: Nobody knows. Grandpa ate one and croaked all week!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {gasp} Croaked? Like a frog?

segments.say: Croaked? Like a frog?

lines.speaker: auto-mom
lines.text: {nod} Like a very loud frog. So leave it alone, okay?

segments.say: Like a very loud frog. So leave it alone, okay?

lines.speaker: auto-mom
lines.text: {walk-out} I'm going to water the plants. Be good!

segments.say: I'm going to water the plants. Be good!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {tiptoe} {pick:sandwich} Just one tiny bite later… for science.

segments.say: Just one tiny bite later… for science.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {facepalm} Peddy, no! That is a terrible idea.

segments.say: Peddy, no! That is a terrible idea.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {giggle} Relax! I'll only look at it. Promise.

segments.say: Relax! I'll only look at it. Promise.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {carry:basket} Okay, basket is full. Juice, cake, normal sandwiches.

segments.say: Okay, basket is full. Juice, cake, normal sandwiches.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {look-around} {hide} Shh! Is Mom watching?

segments.say: Shh! Is Mom watching?

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {hmm} Why are you hiding behind the sofa?

segments.say: Why are you hiding behind the sofa?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: No reason! Totally normal hiding. {smile}

segments.say: No reason! Totally normal hiding.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {sigh} You took the green sandwich, didn't you?

segments.say: You took the green sandwich, didn't you?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {oops} Maybe. A little. It's in the basket.

segments.say: Maybe. A little. It's in the basket.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {uff} If you turn into a frog, I'm not carrying you!

segments.say: If you turn into a frog, I'm not carrying you!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {carry:basket} This basket is heavier than me! {sweat}

segments.say: This basket is heavier than me!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {look-around} Walk faster before Mom sees us!

segments.say: Walk faster before Mom sees us!

lines.speaker: auto-dog
lines.text: {show:dog} {bark} Woof! I smell something magic!

segments.say: Woof! I smell something magic!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {step-back} {scared} Nice doggy… go away, doggy!

segments.say: Nice doggy… go away, doggy!

lines.speaker: auto-dog
lines.text: {sniff} Hmm, green bread? No thanks, I like bones. {walk-out}

segments.say: Hmm, green bread? No thanks, I like bones.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {laugh} Even the dog is scared of it!

segments.say: Even the dog is scared of it!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {shake-head} That's not funny. That's a warning!

segments.say: That's not funny. That's a warning!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {wow} Look at this place! Trees, birds, and a pond!

segments.say: Look at this place! Trees, birds, and a pond!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {drop:basket} {uff} Finally! My arms are noodles now.

segments.say: Finally! My arms are noodles now.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {eat:sandwich} Mmm! Normal sandwich number one, done!

segments.say: Mmm! Normal sandwich number one, done!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {drink} Ahh, cold juice. This is the best day ever!

segments.say: Ahh, cold juice. This is the best day ever!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {hmm} Now… for dessert. {show:sandwich} The glowing one!

segments.say: Now… for dessert.
The glowing one!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {shake-head} Peddy, Mom said NO!

segments.say: Peddy, Mom said NO!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: Just one bite. What could go wrong? {smile}

segments.say: Just one bite. What could go wrong?

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {facepalm} Everything! Everything could go wrong!

segments.say: Everything! Everything could go wrong!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {oops} Too late! {eat} Crunch!

segments.say: Too late!
Crunch!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {dizzy} Teddy… why is everything so… big?

segments.say: Teddy… why is everything so… big?

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {gasp} PEDDY! {turn:Peddy:frog}

segments.say: PEDDY!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {ribbit} Ribbit?! Why is my voice so croaky?

segments.say: Ribbit?! Why is my voice so croaky?

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {aah} You are a FROG! A green, jumpy frog!

segments.say: You are a FROG! A green, jumpy frog!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {cry} I don't want to eat flies forever!

segments.say: I don't want to eat flies forever!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {pace} Don't panic. Think, Teddy, think! {think}

segments.say: Don't panic. Think, Teddy, think!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {jump} I can't stop jumping! Boing! Boing!

segments.say: I can't stop jumping! Boing! Boing!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {laugh} Sorry… sorry, it's a little bit funny.

segments.say: Sorry… sorry, it's a little bit funny.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {angry} It is NOT funny! Ribbit!

segments.say: It is NOT funny! Ribbit!

lines.speaker: auto-cat
lines.text: {show:cat} {meow} Ooh, a juicy little frog for my breakfast!

segments.say: Ooh, a juicy little frog for my breakfast!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {scared} {hide} Teddy, help! The cat wants to eat me!

segments.say: Teddy, help! The cat wants to eat me!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {run} Shoo, cat! That frog is my best friend! {chase}

segments.say: Shoo, cat! That frog is my best friend!

lines.speaker: auto-cat
lines.text: {hiss} Fine, fine! Nobody shares anything anymore. {walk-out}

segments.say: Fine, fine! Nobody shares anything anymore.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {sigh} Thank you, Teddy. Now how do I turn back?

segments.say: Thank you, Teddy. Now how do I turn back?

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {idea} Maybe the pond knows! Frogs love ponds!

segments.say: Maybe the pond knows! Frogs love ponds!

lines.speaker: auto-duck
lines.text: {show:duck} {quack} Hello! Why is that little frog crying?

segments.say: Hello! Why is that little frog crying?

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {walk-to} She ate a magic sandwich. Can you help us?

segments.say: She ate a magic sandwich. Can you help us?

lines.speaker: auto-duck
lines.text: {laugh} Easy! Magic washes off in water. Jump in!

segments.say: Easy! Magic washes off in water. Jump in!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {jump} Here I go! {swim:pond}

segments.say: Here I go!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {look-around} Still a frog! Still croaky! Ribbit!

segments.say: Still a frog! Still croaky! Ribbit!

lines.speaker: auto-duck
lines.text: {oops} Oh, pond water is too lazy. You need waterfall water!

segments.say: Oh, pond water is too lazy. You need waterfall water!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {shock} A waterfall? Where do we find one?

segments.say: A waterfall? Where do we find one?

lines.speaker: auto-duck
lines.text: {point} Past the farm, through the forest, over the bridge.

segments.say: Past the farm, through the forest, over the bridge.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {uff} That sounds very far for tiny frog legs.

segments.say: That sounds very far for tiny frog legs.

lines.speaker: auto-duck
lines.text: {walk-to} Don't worry. I'll show you the way. Quack!

segments.say: Don't worry. I'll show you the way. Quack!

lines.speaker: auto-cow
lines.text: {show:cow} {moo} Mooo! Who is stepping on my grass?

segments.say: Mooo! Who is stepping on my grass?

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {step-back} Sorry, Mrs. Cow! We're looking for the waterfall.

segments.say: Sorry, Mrs. Cow! We're looking for the waterfall.

lines.speaker: auto-cow
lines.text: {hmm} The waterfall? Why does a boy need a waterfall?

segments.say: The waterfall? Why does a boy need a waterfall?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {ribbit} Not him. Me! I'm a frog by accident!

segments.say: Not him. Me! I'm a frog by accident!

lines.speaker: auto-cow
lines.text: {laugh} By accident? Let me guess. The green sandwich?

segments.say: By accident? Let me guess. The green sandwich?

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {gasp} How did you know?!

segments.say: How did you know?!

lines.speaker: auto-cow
lines.text: {nod} Grandpa came here last year. Croaking. Very loud.

segments.say: Grandpa came here last year. Croaking. Very loud.

lines.speaker: auto-pig
lines.text: {show:pig} {oink} He jumped in my mud puddle! Twice!

segments.say: He jumped in my mud puddle! Twice!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {facepalm} Grandpa, what were you doing?

segments.say: Grandpa, what were you doing?

lines.speaker: auto-cow
lines.text: {point} Go through the forest. Follow the river. You'll hear the waterfall.

segments.say: Go through the forest. Follow the river. You'll hear the waterfall.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {wave} Thank you, Mrs. Cow! Thank you, Mr. Pig!

segments.say: Thank you, Mrs. Cow! Thank you, Mr. Pig!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {carry:log} {sweat} Why am I carrying a log?

segments.say: Why am I carrying a log?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {croak} To cross the river, silly!

segments.say: To cross the river, silly!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {drop:log} Oh wait, there is a bridge. {facepalm}

segments.say: Oh wait, there is a bridge.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {giggle} Frogs are smarter than boys today!

segments.say: Frogs are smarter than boys today!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {cross:bridge} Okay, smarty frog, hop on!

segments.say: Okay, smarty frog, hop on!

lines.speaker: auto-monkey
lines.text: {show:monkey} {climb:tree} Hey! Nobody passes without paying!

segments.say: Hey! Nobody passes without paying!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {gasp} Paying? We only have… sandwiches.

segments.say: Paying? We only have… sandwiches.

lines.speaker: auto-monkey
lines.text: {haan} Sandwiches? {nod} Okay, one sandwich, you may pass.

segments.say: Sandwiches?
Okay, one sandwich, you may pass.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {hmm} Give him the normal one, Teddy! Not the green one!

segments.say: Give him the normal one, Teddy! Not the green one!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {give:sandwich} Here. A normal one, I promise.

segments.say: Here. A normal one, I promise.

lines.speaker: auto-monkey
lines.text: {eat:sandwich} {yay} Delicious! The waterfall is right ahead!

segments.say: Delicious! The waterfall is right ahead!

lines.speaker: auto-duck
lines.text: {quack} See? Almost there! Keep going!

segments.say: See? Almost there! Keep going!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {wow} Look! The *waterfall*! It's sparkling!

segments.say: Look! The *waterfall*! It's sparkling!

lines.speaker: auto-duck
lines.text: {quack} {walk-to} Told you! Now jump in, little frog!

segments.say: Told you! Now jump in, little frog!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {scared} What if it's too cold? What if I sink?

segments.say: What if it's too cold? What if I sink?

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {hug} You can do it. Frogs are great swimmers!

segments.say: You can do it. Frogs are great swimmers!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {jump} Wish me luck! {swim:waterfall}

segments.say: Wish me luck!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {sweat} {look-around} Peddy? Peddy! Are you okay?

segments.say: Peddy? Peddy! Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {turn:Peddy:back} {yay} I'm ME again! No more ribbits!

segments.say: I'm ME again! No more ribbits!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {hug} {cry} I was so worried about you!

segments.say: I was so worried about you!

lines.speaker: auto-duck
lines.text: {clap} Hooray! Magic washed away!

segments.say: Hooray! Magic washed away!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {hmm} So… that sandwich really was magic.

segments.say: So… that sandwich really was magic.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {nod} Very magic. Never eating green bread again!

segments.say: Very magic. Never eating green bread again!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {show:sandwich} Wait… there's still half left in the basket.

segments.say: Wait… there's still half left in the basket.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {shock} Throw it away, Teddy!

segments.say: Throw it away, Teddy!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {think} But… it smells so good. Like cookies and pizza together.

segments.say: But… it smells so good. Like cookies and pizza together.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {angry} TEDDY. Don't you dare!

segments.say: TEDDY. Don't you dare!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {oops} {eat} Oops… I was hungry!

segments.say: Oops… I was hungry!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {facepalm} Oh no, not again!

segments.say: Oh no, not again!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {dizzy} {become:frog} Ribbit?!

segments.say: Ribbit?!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {laugh} Now YOU are the frog!

segments.say: Now YOU are the frog!

lines.speaker: auto-duck
lines.text: {quack} {laugh} The waterfall is right there, froggy!

segments.say: The waterfall is right there, froggy!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {croak} This is so embarrassing. Don't tell anyone!

segments.say: This is so embarrassing. Don't tell anyone!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {giggle} I'm telling everyone.

segments.say: I'm telling everyone.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {jump} {swim:waterfall} Here I go!

segments.say: Here I go!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {turn:Teddy:back} {wow} Back to normal! Ha!

segments.say: Back to normal! Ha!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {high-five} Best picnic ever!

segments.say: Best picnic ever!

lines.speaker: auto-duck
lines.text: {wave} Bye, frogs! I mean, bye, friends! {walk-out}

segments.say: Bye, frogs! I mean, bye, friends!

lines.speaker: auto-mom
lines.text: {hmm} So… where is Grandpa's magic sandwich?

segments.say: So… where is Grandpa's magic sandwich?

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {sweat} {look-around} Sandwich? What sandwich?

segments.say: Sandwich? What sandwich?

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {smile} We… gave it to a monkey?

segments.say: We… gave it to a monkey?

lines.speaker: auto-mom
lines.text: {angry} You ATE it, didn't you?!

segments.say: You ATE it, didn't you?!

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {nod} Just a little. And we turned into frogs.

segments.say: Just a little. And we turned into frogs.

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: But the waterfall fixed us! Good as new! {smile} {fix}

segments.say: But the waterfall fixed us! Good as new!

lines.speaker: auto-mom
lines.text: {sigh} Then you two can wash all the picnic plates.

segments.say: Then you two can wash all the picnic plates.

lines.speaker: 6d7bf361b7fd
lines.text: {uff} Being a frog was easier!

segments.say: Being a frog was easier!

lines.speaker: 8f31b59119cb
lines.text: {laugh} Ribbit!

segments.say: Ribbit!
